'''Oorrl Morm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].

Morm served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], crafting the [[Greelwood Saber/Legends|Greelwood Saber]] during his time there. Wielding the weapon in battle on [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] against [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], Morm bought the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] enough time to launch an effective attack on the pirates, at the cost of his life. Morm's weapon was returned to Ossus and stored within the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library's]] [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]].<ref name="NoP" />
